note: SYNTHETIC model - the owner's example case ('a ~211 GB model on a 192 GB VRAM box'). NOT a real checkpoint: components are a scaled-down, same-architecture cousin of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (40 layers, 384 routed experts, top-6, CSA2 KV, Engram tables). Every number here is synthetic and labeled; use it only to demonstrate the placement engine, never as a serving promise. The budget schema is real (checkpoint-budget.py output shape).

routed_experts.note: synthetic: ~62% of the DSV4.1 expert bytes

engram_table.note: synthetic: one-third of the DSV4.1 table bytes

dspark.note: synthetic: same draft heads as DSV4.1 (spec off by default)

attention.note: synthetic: same dense architecture as DSV4.1

arch.notes: Synthetic arch = DSV4.1's activation structure. KV and Engram row geometry carried over because the 'host' is the same box; a real 211 GB model would re-measure both.
